title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory is looking for a highly organised, proactive Executive Assistant to support its Leadership Team on a full-time, permanent basis, based in Coventry, West Midlands.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Competitive Salary:£35,000 - £45,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Holiday: 30 days annual leave, including bank holidays
- Hybrid and flexible working
- Additional Benefits: Company car or car allowance, profit share scheme and private healthcare after a qualifying period, plus free quality lunch four days a week, reward lunches, team building days, professional development opportunities, and a supportive and collaborative working environment.

About the role:

As an Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level support to the Leadership Team, managing diaries, meetings, events, reports, projects and key deadlines while acting as a trusted link with the wider business. You will be proactive, commercially aware and highly organised, with the discretion to handle confidential information and the confidence to anticipate priorities, work independently and ensure tasks are followed through.

Duties and Responsibilities include:
- Manage Leadership Team calendars, meetings, appointments and priorities, ensuring schedules run smoothly
- Prepare agendas, meeting papers, presentations and regular reports, ensuring accurate and timely information
- Coordinate meetings, offsites, strategy days and client events, including venues, catering and technology
- Take minutes, track actions and deadlines, and proactively follow up to ensure tasks are completed
- Manage Leadership Team inboxes and act as a key communication link with the wider business
- Support projects and ad hoc business requirements while handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion

About you:

To be a successful Executive Assistant, you will have proven experience providing executive or senior-level administrative support, ideally within a professional services or accountancy environment. You will be highly organised, proactive and confident managing multiple priorities, with excellent communication and IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Strong calendar management and minute-taking skills are essential, alongside excellent attention to detail, discretion and the ability to build effective relationships. You will be a confident problem-solver who can manage deadlines, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of your workload.

Why Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory:

Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory is a modern, forward-thinking accountancy practice based in Coventry, with over 50 years experience supporting small and medium-sized businesses. Providing expert accounting, tax and business growth advice, the firm helps clients improve profitability, cash flow and long-term value through tailored, results-driven solutions. With a strong focus on growth and professional development, Oldfield fosters a supportive culture built around five core values: Own It, Be Passionate, Go Further, Create Solutions and Earn Confidence.

If you have all the relevant skills and experience for the Executive Assistant role and would like to be considered, please apply by forwarding an up-to-date CV as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you require any reasonable adjustments such as access or information in an alternative format, please inform us soon as you are able so that we can make the appropriate adjustments.

No recruitment agencies, please

When you apply, your details are processed and available for us to directly review for this vacancy. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. For full Privacy Policy details please see email correspondences on receipt of your application.

title: E-Commerce Administrator
description:
E-Commerce Administrator Bidford-on-Avon, Warwickshire

E-Commerce Administrator £30,000 per annum (dependent on experience) Full-Time, Permanent Early finish Friday 25 days holiday + bank holidays Private healthcare

Do you know your way around Amazon Seller Central and want a role with more variety than a pure marketplace job? Our client, a growing e-commerce business near Bidford-on-Avon, is looking for a well-rounded E-Commerce Administrator to take ownership of their Amazon channel and to get stuck into the logistics and marketing that sit either side of it.

This is deliberately a multi-hat role. Amazon is the core of it, but you'll also coordinate order fulfilment and returns, and support the marketing that drives online sales. It will suit someone who enjoys variety and wants to grow with an expanding online operation, rather than a specialist who only wants to work in one lane. Commutable from Alcester, Stratford-upon-Avon, Evesham, Redditch and Studley.

Key Details
- Job Title: E-Commerce Administrator (Amazon Marketplace)
- Salary: £30,000 per annum, dependent on experience
- Contract: Permanent, full-time
- Location: Near Bidford-on-Avon, Warwickshire office based
- Hours: Monday to Thursday 07 00, Friday 07 00 (some flexibility available for the right person)

About the Role

The role splits three ways: Amazon marketplace management, order and returns logistics, and marketing support. You will make sure products are listed accurately and compliantly, orders reach Amazon and other fulfilment locations on time, and opportunities to grow online sales are spotted and acted on. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, logistics and marketing, and have real scope to shape how the marketplace operation develops.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon and online marketplaces
- Create, maintain and update product listings across Amazon and other online marketplaces
- Review and optimise product content to improve visibility, customer engagement and sales performance
- Check that all products meet Amazon's compliance standards for the UK and EU
- Support the ongoing development and growth of the Amazon marketplace presence
- Research and explore opportunities to expand into additional online marketplaces and sales channels
- Resolve marketplace queries and support customers where required

Order administration and logistics
- Coordinate and manage the administration of customer orders, ensuring timely delivery to Amazon and other fulfilment locations
- Monitor and manage returns from Amazon, including overstocked, damaged or slow-selling items

Marketing support
- Support the wider team with marketing activity linked to online sales product content, promotions and campaign support

What We're Looking For
- Hands-on experience of Amazon Seller Central or Amazon Vendor Central this is essential
- Someone genuinely well-rounded, who is happy wearing several hats across marketplace, logistics and marketing rather than working in a single specialism
- Previous administration experience, ideally within e-commerce, sales support or logistics
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- The ability to work independently, self-motivated and able to problem solve
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Confidence working with data, product information and online systems
- Good communication skills and the ability to liaise with multiple stakeholders
- A proactive approach and a willingness to identify process improvements and growth opportunities

Desirable
- Experience with Amazon PPC advertising, including budget monitoring, keyword and search optimisation, and reporting on ACOS / ROAS
- Understanding of other online marketplaces such as eBay, TEMU, Joybuy or similar
- Comfortable working with API-driven reports and automated data tools, or happy to learn the systems that feed them
- Any marketing experience product photography, copywriting, email or social
- Strong IT skills confident picking up new software and troubleshooting everyday technical issues independently

What's On Offer
- £30,000 per annum + dependent on experience
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Private healthcare through Vitality
- Death in service insurance
- Early finish on a Friday (3pm)
- A genuinely varied role with scope to grow alongside an expanding e-commerce operation

How to Apply

If you have hands-on Amazon experience and you're looking for a broader role E-Commerce Administrator, Marketplace Administrator, Amazon Account Administrator or Ecommerce Assistant apply today with an up-to-date CV.

title: Administrator - Purchasing
description:
An excellent opportunity for a Purchasing Administrator to join a global manufacturer based in Southam in their purchasing team. Reporting into the Purchasing Manager, you will be responsible for providing accurate and efficient administration support for purchasing, production and stores departments.

Working closely with the Purchasing Manager to ensure that all the below are achieved and maintained so that customer delivery requirements are met and on time.
- Raise purchase orders for both stock and non-stock items.
- Liaise with suppliers to negotiate the best prices, dependent on delivery required, ensuring the suppliers are quoting like for like products.

- Computer literacy, capable of using Sage Accounts, Internet, email and the Microsoft Office suite

- Conscientious and diligent with a keen eye for detail
- Self-motivated and capable of using initiative.
- High importance to attention to detail is a key point.
